VoiceStudio

AI voice studio. On your device.

Clone, design, dub, dictate, transcribe and narrate in 646 languages.

Runs on your laptop, desktop, servers, phone, tablets and more

## What you can do

Voice cloning
Turn a clean reference recording into speech in a familiar voice.
Video dubbing
Translate and dub videos with speech timed to the original.

Voice design
Describe a voice in words and generate it.
Local models
Choose your engines and download only the models you need.
More screenshots

Workspace overview
Model packs
- **Dictate & transcribe** — A floating dictation widget and local transcription - **Narrate & batch** — Stories, audiobooks and queued jobs - **Connect & automate** — Local API, MCP, reusable recipes and watch folders Start with **VoiceStudio** (default, powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice), or pick from dozens of other engines in the Model Manager. Native GGUF engines can also use Vulkan on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs; OmniVoice GGUF picks its GPU and model size automatically on Windows and Linux ([OmniVoice](docs/engines/omnivoice-gguf.md#vulkan-acceleration), [CosyVoice](docs/engines/cosyvoice-gguf.md)). Speed by engine and hardware: [performance](docs/performance.md). ## Get started **macOS / Linux** ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh ``` **Windows** (PowerShell) ```powershell irm https://voicestudio.sh/install.ps1 | iex ``` Or download an installer from the table above. Then open **Voice cloning**, pick a voice or add a clean reference recording, type your text and generate. The app asks before it downloads any model. > [!NOTE] > On macOS, "VoiceStudio is damaged and can't be opened" means Gatekeeper blocked the app, not that the download is broken. See the [Gatekeeper fix](docs/install/macos.md#gatekeeper-quarantine).
More install options: a specific version, current main, uninstall, from source, with a coding agent ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # a specific release curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # build current main curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall # remove the app, keep your data ``` If `voicestudio.sh` is unreachable, run the script straight from the repository: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`. Prerequisites and behavior: [installer guide](docs/install/script.md). **From source** ```bash git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio bun run dev ``` `bun run dev` installs the JavaScript dependencies and, when using a supported local backend, the Python dependencies before launching Electron. Run `bun run setup:api` directly when you only need to rebuild the Python environment. See [Electron setup](electron/README.md). **With a coding agent** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …), paste: ```text Install the VoiceStudio app on this device and verify it works, following https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/main/docs/install/agent.md ``` Upgrading from 0.5.3 or older (the Tauri app)? [Install the new app separately](docs/electron-migration.md).

VoiceStudio

AI 语音工作室，就在你的设备上。

支持 646 种语言的声音克隆、声音设计、配音、听写、转录与有声朗读。

可在你的笔记本电脑、台式机、服务器、手机、平板电脑等设备上运行

## 你可以做什么

声音克隆
用一段清晰的参考录音，生成熟悉声音的语音。
视频配音
翻译并配音视频，让语音与原片时间对齐。

声音设计
用文字描述你想要的声音，然后生成。
本地模型
自由选择引擎，只下载你需要的模型。

模型组合
- **听写与转录** — 悬浮听写窗口与本地转录 - **朗读与批量处理** — 故事、有声书与排队任务 - **连接与自动化** — 本地 API、MCP、可复用配方与监视文件夹 从默认的 **VoiceStudio**（由 k2-fsa/OmniVoice 驱动）开始，或在模型管理器中从数十种其他引擎中挑选。参见[功能与引擎目录](../../docs/feature-catalog.md)。 ## 支持平台 | 平台与状态 | 下载与加速 | | :--- | :--- | |  **macOS**（Apple Silicon）

仅应用界面，需连接远程后端 | 桌面端和手机安装包都在[最新发行版](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest)中，Docker 镜像则发布在 GHCR。没有 GPU？应用在 CPU 上也能完整使用，只是速度较慢。原生 GGUF 引擎还能通过 Vulkan 使用 AMD、Intel 和 NVIDIA GPU；在 Windows 和 Linux 上，OmniVoice GGUF 会自动选择 GPU 和模型量化（[OmniVoice](../../docs/engines/omnivoice-gguf.md#vulkan-acceleration)、[CosyVoice](../../docs/engines/cosyvoice-gguf.md)）。各引擎在不同硬件上的速度：[性能说明](../../docs/performance.md)。 ## 开始使用 **macOS / Linux** ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh ``` **Windows**（PowerShell） ```powershell irm https://voicestudio.sh/install.ps1 | iex ``` 也可以从上表下载安装包。然后打开**声音克隆**，选择声音或添加一段清晰的参考录音，输入文本并生成。下载任何模型之前，应用都会先征求你的同意。 > [!NOTE] > 在 macOS 上看到“VoiceStudio 已损坏，无法打开”，是 Gatekeeper 拦截了应用，并不是下载文件损坏。参见 [Gatekeeper 修复方法](../../docs/install/macos.md#gatekeeper-quarantine)。
更多安装方式：指定版本、当前 main、卸载、从源码安装、通过编码智能体安装 ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # 安装指定版本 curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # 构建当前 main curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall # 卸载应用，保留数据 ``` 如果无法访问 `voicestudio.sh`，可直接从仓库运行脚本： `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`。 前置要求与脚本行为：[安装脚本说明](../../docs/install/script.md)。 **从源码安装** ```bash git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio bun run dev ``` 参见 [Electron 设置](../../electron/README.md)。 **通过编码智能体安装**（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等），粘贴： ```text Install the VoiceStudio app on this device and verify it works, following https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/main/docs/install/agent.md ``` 从 0.5.3 或更早版本（Tauri 应用）升级？请[单独安装新应用](../../docs/electron-migration.md)。
